name: Entity ESP
description: Highlight nearby players, creatures and items.

name: Storage ESP
description: Highlight nearby containers.

name: Tracers
description: Draw lines from your view to nearby entities.

name: Fullbright
description: Lift world lighting for clearer exploration.

name: Coordinates
description: Show position and dimension in your HUD.

name: Crosshair
description: A crisp customizable crosshair.

name: Particles
description: Animated ambient particles in the Analyzer menu.

name: Interface
description: Glass or solid panels, accent colors and motion control.

name: Sky Aurora
description: Animated sky curtains, stars and cosmic color above your world.

name: Atmosphere
description: Cinematic bloom and color grading. Sky Aurora controls the sky.

name: HUD Studio
description: Theme, scale and position controls for your entire HUD.

name: Watermark
description: Analyzer identity and version badge.

name: Active Modules
description: A bounded list of enabled gameplay modules.

name: FPS
description: Current client frames per second.

name: Ping
description: Actual player latency reported by the server.

name: Speed HUD
description: Horizontal movement speed in blocks per second.

name: Armor
description: Equipped armor icons with remaining durability.

name: Potion Effects
description: Active effects, levels and remaining durations.

name: Target HUD
description: Health and armor of your acquired combat or crosshair target.

name: Keybinds
description: Assigned module binds with their enabled state.

name: Inventory Preview
description: Your actual inventory in a compact three-row panel.

name: Compass
description: Yaw-based cardinal direction and heading.

name: Biome
description: Registry name of the biome at your current position.

name: World Clock
description: World time of day and current day number.

name: Item Counter
description: Count a selected resource in your inventory and offhand.

name: Keystrokes
description: Live movement, jump and mouse-button states.

name: Target Distance
description: Measured camera distance to the current raycast hit.

name: Place Animation
description: Ease a colored block ghost into each successful placement.

name: Break Animation
description: Mining progress, dissolving block ghosts and debris on successful breaks.

name: Place Preview
description: Show the actual adjacent or replaceable block position for your held block.

name: Block Highlight
description: A pulsing outline of the block under your crosshair.

name: Hit Particles
description: Colored sparks when loaded living entities are actually hurt.

name: Jump Circles
description: Expanding floor ripples when you leave the ground with upward velocity.

name: Trails
description: A fading ribbon following your actual movement.

name: Damage Numbers
description: Floating numbers from actual health decreases of loaded living entities.

name: Hit Markers
description: A brief crosshair flash when your recently attacked target is hurt.

name: Footsteps
description: Small fading floor rings spaced along grounded movement.

name: Death Effects
description: A rising particle burst when a loaded living entity dies.

name: Projectile Trails
description: Fading paths behind actual loaded projectiles.

name: Pickup Streaks
description: A curved streak from an item to the collector on real pickup packets.

name: Teleport Effects
description: Paired energy rings on large local position changes.

name: Player Aura
description: Rotating rings around your actual player position.

name: Target ESP
description: Orbiting target rings on your crosshair target or recently attacked entity.

name: Hole ESP
description: Outline loaded single-block holes with resistant floors and walls.

name: Trajectories
description: Predict a held bow, trident, snowball, egg or pearl path against loaded blocks.

name: Item ESP
description: Independent glowing rings and beams on loaded dropped items.

name: Nametags
description: Independent readable names, health and distances for loaded players and mobs.

name: Explosion Effects
description: Shockwave rings and sparks from actual nearby explosion packets.

name: Totem Pops
description: Golden rings, sparks and a floating pop label on real totem-use statuses.

name: Landing Impact
description: A floor shockwave when a falling player lands.

name: Health Pulse
description: A fading edge vignette when your local health decreases.

name: Kill Aura
description: Attack the nearest selected visible target within vanilla reach and cooldown.

name: Aim Assist
description: Smoothly turn toward a selected target while holding attack.

name: Trigger Bot
description: Attack a selected entity under your crosshair at the configured cooldown.

name: Auto Clicker
description: Repeat entity attacks while you hold attack; respects reach and cooldown.

name: Auto Weapon
description: Select a hotbar melee weapon by its material/damage estimate while attacking.

name: Shield Breaker
description: Select a hotbar axe and attack a visible blocking target at normal reach.

name: Bow Aimbot
description: Aim a drawn bow at a visible target with velocity lead and gravity compensation.

name: Criticals
description: Jump before melee attacks, then attack in the ordinary falling phase. Hold attack or enable an aura.

name: Crystal Aura
description: Place crystals on real obsidian/bedrock and break reachable enemy-near crystals. No damage prediction.

name: Anchor Aura
description: Place, charge and use anchors only in dimensions where they explode. No damage prediction.

name: Surround
description: Place hotbar obsidian around your feet, one normal interaction at a time.

name: Auto Trap
description: Place obsidian around a selected target and above its head with ordinary block use.

name: Auto Web
description: Place hotbar cobweb at a selected target's feet when support and reach permit.

name: Hole Filler
description: Fill nearby one-block holes with a solid floor and four solid walls using obsidian.

name: Target Strafe
description: Move tangentially around the nearest selected visible target; collision remains active.

name: Keep Sprint
description: Hold the normal sprint input while moving forward and able to sprint.

name: Auto Walk
description: Hold forward while the world is focused; releases the input when disabled.

name: Speed
description: Set horizontal client velocity while directional input is held; servers may correct it.

name: Fly
description: Client velocity flight with jump/sneak vertical control; does not grant server flight permission.

name: Step
description: Temporarily raise the client step-height attribute; servers may correct movement.

name: Parkour
description: Jump when approaching an unsupported edge while moving on the ground.

name: Safe Walk
description: Use vanilla ledge clipping without requiring the sneak key.

name: Fast Ladder
description: Increase upward velocity while climbing with forward or jump input.

name: Reverse Step
description: Accelerate downward when falling toward a nearby floor.

name: Fast Fall
description: Accelerate an existing fall after the configured distance; no fall-damage spoof.

name: Glide
description: Limit ordinary falling velocity outside fluids; servers may correct it.

name: High Jump
description: Increase upward velocity at the start of a normal jump.

name: Long Jump
description: Add horizontal velocity at the start of a normal directional jump.

name: Elytra Boost
description: Add a bounded impulse in the view direction while already gliding.

name: Ground Strafe
description: Align existing horizontal momentum with your ground movement input.

name: Auto Eat
description: Eat hotbar food below a hunger threshold; temporarily owns and restores use input/slot.

name: Auto Gapple
description: Use a hotbar golden apple below a health threshold.

name: Auto Totem
description: Swap an inventory totem into the offhand through the normal player inventory handler.

name: Auto Armor
description: Equip stronger material-tier armor through guarded normal inventory quick moves.

name: Auto Tool
description: Choose the fastest hotbar tool for the block you are actively mining.

name: Refill
description: Swap larger matching inventory stacks into low hotbar stacks.

name: Anti AFK
description: Periodically turn and jump using ordinary input, while no menu is open.

name: Auto Respawn
description: Request an ordinary respawn after the death screen delay.

name: Durability Alert
description: Show a periodic warning for low-durability equipped items.

name: Auto Fish
description: Reel on the server-synchronized caught-fish flag, then optionally cast again.

name: Scaffold
description: Place hotbar blocks underneath your feet using ordinary block interactions.

name: Tower
description: While holding jump, rise onto automatically placed hotbar blocks.

name: Air Place
description: While holding use, attempt to place a block at your crosshair in empty air.

name: Nuker
description: Mine nearby reachable blocks one at a time with normal mining progress.

name: Auto Farm
description: Harvest mature crops and replant empty farmland using hotbar seeds.

name: Auto Tunnel
description: Mine a two-block-tall path in the direction you face.

name: Bed Breaker
description: Find and mine reachable beds using normal mining progress.

name: Flatten
description: Mine reachable blocks above your standing level; preserve the floor.

name: Speed Mine
description: Remove the client delay between ordinary block breaks; server mining rules still apply.

name: Vein Miner
description: After a manual break, mine connected blocks of the same type within reach.

name: No Block Interact
description: Use block placement against containers without opening them.

name: Chest Stealer
description: Quick-move items from an open container at a bounded rate.

name: Middle Click Friend
description: Middle-click a player to add or remove a locally saved friend.

name: Player Detection
description: Notify locally when a non-friend enters your selected radius.

name: Notifier
description: Local messages for loaded players arriving or departing.

name: Coord Snapper
description: Copy your coordinates to the clipboard, then turn off automatically.
